text.T001:
AI delivery governance & agentic
      operating models
text.T005: Vitalii Oborskyi · Enterprise delivery leader & independent research author.
text.T006: My work combines enterprise software delivery leadership with independent research into how AI changes engineering, operating models and the systems we build.
text.T007: Research, publications, talks and practical engineering experiments.
text.T012: AI is a fundamental shift: an attempt to delegate parts of thinking to machines.
text.T013:
More than 20 years in software engineering and technology delivery, including over a decade
      in leadership. Delivery and PMO responsibility across a portfolio of around 25 projects
      and more than 120 engineers. That experience shapes my research into software delivery
      and systems that depend on model judgment.
